_README: Hand overrides for build-worlddata.py. Merged LAST, so edits here survive every
regeneration. Never hand-edit GTA/scripts/gta11y-worlddata.json — it is generated.
Same provenance model as menulabels-overrides.json: every row carries a status and
status: 'verified' — confirmed in-game or from a second source. Wins outright.
'assumed'  — a considered guess. Ships, but is flagged as such.
'refuted'  — the harvested row is wrong; this REMOVES it.
evidence: free text naming what proved it (a session date, a script + line, a
second dump). Rows without evidence are hard to re-audit later.
